timeline.text: Driving past Hoff, a small place on the daily route, the guide stayed silent — it only knew spots added by hand.
Now it pulls straight from Kartverket, Norway's own official register of place names.
It keeps real farms, holdings and hamlets near the road, skips plain addresses, and looks up a local wiki page to back each name.
Each name even gets translated into Ukrainian — as long as it sits within five hundred meters of the road.
